projects.description: For this project, I focused on putting basic JavaScript syntax into action. I built an interactive Random Quote Generator that leverages arrays and objects to pull and display a new piece of text to the screen with every button click.

For this project, I focused on improving the user experience when handling large datasets. I used JavaScript to take a massive list of student data and break it down into smaller, manageable 'pages' with interactive navigation, ensuring the interface never feels overwhelming.

Forms are the backbone of data collection on the web, so I used this project to focus on making them highly interactive and user-friendly. I wrote custom JavaScript to catch errors and validate user input in real-time, making the overall flow engaging and intuitive to use.

For this project, I dove deep into Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) to build a browser-based word guessing game called Phrase Hunter. I structured the code using JavaScript classes to cleanly manage the game logic, handle the onscreen keyboard interactions, and track the player's remaining attempts.

For this project, I focused on asynchronous programming by communicating with a third-party API. I built an employee directory that uses JavaScript to request data from an external server, parse the resulting JSON, and dynamically display the information on the page.
